title: Year-to-year control of hypoxia off the Pearl River Estuary
query: Using the supplied CMOMS daily oxygen, temperature, salinity, chlorophyll and velocity for 2011-2020, quantify how summer bottom hypoxia (dissolved oxygen below 2 mg/L) on the shelf off the Pearl River Estuary varies from year to year and determine which physical and biological factors control it. River discharge, nutrients and winds are not supplied.
